description: The Massachusetts Marine Trades Association welcomes Representative Jessica Giannino(D-16th Suffolk) as the new Co-Chair of the Legislative Boating Caucus. Hailing from a waterfront district with a rich maritime history, Representative Giannino will undoubtedly help protect and support the recreational boating industry. title: MMTA Welcomes Rep. Giannino as House Co-Chair of theLegislative Boating Caucus
